summary.intent: Execute Phase 26 (Observability & UX Tuning) for the cipher-box project, delivering Grafana alert rules and client timeout/retry tuning, then get it merged via PR.
summary.outcome: Phase 26 was fully executed with 14/14 must-haves verified, a PR was created (FSM1/cipher-box#366), and iterated through multiple review cycles fixing CI failures, merge conflicts, and CodeRabbit/Copilot review comments until all threads were resolved.

repo: Grafana Cloud Free tier has a 10,000 active series limit — Kubo IPFS node scrapes alone can exceed this due to DHT routing, bitswap per-peer, and libp2p protocol metrics
The dashboard only uses 6 external metrics from Kubo/Someguy: go_goroutines, go_memstats_alloc_bytes, libp2p_swarm_connections_opened/closed_total, libp2p_network_in/out_bytes_total
The HTTP metrics histogram uses 'route' as a label — unmatched paths (bot/scanner traffic hitting /wp-admin, /.env) each create 11 unique series (9 buckets + sum + count)
Phase 26 feature branch was created from an older main commit; by the time of PR, main had gained PRs #360, #361, #363 with desktop auto-updater, Phase 24 bug fixes, and E2E test auth fixes
The GSD tooling was pointed at cipher-box (original repo) rather than cipher-box-ci-debug (the active working copy), causing init failures until the correct working directory was used
Merge conflict resolution taking the branch version of ROADMAP.md/STATE.md/REQUIREMENTS.md lost Phase 24 and 25 completion marks that existed on main

code.finding: Added prometheus.relabel filter stage to only forward the 6 metrics actually used in dashboards from Kubo/Someguy scrapes, dramatically reducing active series count

NestJS req.route.path includes the full path with controller prefix (e.g., /ipfs/upload not just /upload) — Copilot's claim that it only returns handler fragments was incorrect, confirmed by existing dashboard queries filtering on full paths
Removed normalizeRoute method entirely — matched routes use NestJS parameterized templates already; unmatched paths now collapse to /:unmatched to cap HTTP histogram label cardinality
Tests hardcoded baseDelayMs=1000 and backoff=2000; after timeout tuning changed baseDelayMs to 500, assertions failed in CI (expected 1000, 2000, 1000 → fixed to 500, 1000, 500)

Provisioning script was taking Grafana API key as positional argv — changed to prefer GRAFANA_API_KEY env var for security; also made alert deployment idempotent via PUT on existing rules vs always POST
Alert was named 'DB Fallback Rate' but measured delegated routing backend fallbacks, not database fallbacks — PromQL metric name was misleading and needed correction

workflow: git diff main..HEAD shows both new work AND apparent removals when main has advanced since branch creation — the 'removals' are commits on main that the branch doesn't have yet, not accidental deletions
After merge conflict resolution in planning docs, always verify that completion markers ([x], dates, progress tables) from prior phases are preserved — merge often takes the older branch version
The GSD plan-phase workflow detects existing plans and skips to results without re-planning, but requires the correct working directory for gsd-tools init to find the right .planning/ folder
When CI tests fail due to hardcoded constants that changed during implementation, the fix is always to update the test expectations to match the new intended values

friction: GSD tools initialized against the wrong repo (cipher-box vs cipher-box-ci-debug), causing 'no plans found' error that required manual directory investigation
Phase 26 plans already existed but execute-phase reported 'no plans' on first invocation due to wrong working directory
Merge conflict resolution silently dropped Phase 24 and 25 completion marks from ROADMAP.md, STATE.md, and REQUIREMENTS.md — required 4 separate Edit operations to restore
CI caught a test regression (delegated-routing.client.spec.ts) that local test runs missed because the timeout tuning change wasn't reflected in test assertions
7 CodeRabbit review threads were all planning doc inconsistencies caused by the merge — none were actual code issues, requiring a full review-resolve cycle for housekeeping work
PR 365 review comment interrupted mid-investigation (user cancelled) — had to context-switch back to PR 366
open_items: Alert JSON files (~877 lines across 5 files) have high structural duplication — a config table + template approach would significantly reduce this but was deferred as out of scope
5s delegated routing timeout (down from 10s) may be aggressive under load for delegated-ipfs.dev (external DHT-backed service) — worth monitoring after deploy
PR #365 (fix/recovery-e2e-kubo-ipns) has a nitpick comment that was identified as valid but investigation was interrupted — still needs to be applied
Grafana Cloud series count should be verified after deploying the Alloy filter changes to confirm the free tier limit is no longer hit
